tasks.title: Bootstrap the workspace
deliverables: Pin Node/pnpm/dependencies; establish layout and nonempty check/build/doctor scripts.
Record prerequisites, platform compatibility and supported versions; initialize a dedicated Git repository only if absent.
Create runnable application/service skeletons and test entry points, not merely empty manifests.
acceptance: A clean dependency installation and build succeed or an exact host prerequisite is recorded.
Doctor reports model/DB/VM capabilities without credentials; no unavailable suite is represented as passing.

tasks.title: Separate trusted runtime services
deliverables: Compose configuration, service-specific volumes/networks and DB credentials.
Local owner bootstrap and environment-variable validation; no real secrets in source.
acceptance: External service cannot read private DB/storage or obtain model/release credentials.
Default listeners are loopback; missing config fails explicitly; ordinary startup does not launch untrusted jobs.
Real browser requests to contributor host contain no private session credential; cookies are host-only and origins explicitly allowed.

tasks.title: Synthetic private application and demo seed
deliverables: A small React/TypeScript private app with proprietary scoring/eligibility fixtures, an initially coupled coherent selection UI/API flow, ranker adapter and data-only response-security policy/loader.
Canaries, pre-change revisions and independently authored requirements; reference solutions separate from planner inputs.
acceptance: Fixture includes single-unit, coherent full-stack and executable response-security policy goals, plus unsupported cloud/data/tooling candidates. Full-stack work follows one UI-to-API outcome rather than unrelated bundled exercises.
Reset/seed touches only identified synthetic data; reference fixes and canaries are not public assets.

tasks.title: Typed contracts and immutable hashes
deliverables: Zod types, canonicalization version and positive public projections.
Valid/invalid fixture examples for all schema types from ARCHITECTURE.
Define nonexclusive disciplines, WorkUnit/PublicInterface arrays, adapter versions, exact edit ownership and aggregate end-to-end requirements; no exclusive task-family discriminator.
acceptance: Unknown privileged fields are rejected; external DTOs contain no internal provenance.
Identical canonical content hashes identically; one-byte changes invalidate its digest; path collisions are rejected.
Single-unit, frontend+backend and frontend+backend+policy contracts validate; conflicting path/schema ownership, dangling links and unknown capabilities are rejected.

tasks.title: Transactional workflow and migrations
deliverables: Service-specific migrations, workflow invariants, version checks and idempotency constraints.
Private intent/approval/evaluation/ledger and external task/reservation/submission persistence.
acceptance: Invalid, stale and concurrent transitions cannot bypass the workflow.
Migration from empty DB works; accepted records bind exact contract/package/submission revisions.

tasks.title: Role and session enforcement
deliverables: Separate session keys/cookies, invitation redemption, CSRF and role checks.
Response/error allowlists and ID-based authorization tests.
acceptance: Requester/contributor cannot impersonate owner or approve release/acceptance.
Cross-contributor and private-resource access fails server-side; invalid sessions and revoked invitations fail.

tasks.title: Private evidence and pinned snapshots
deliverables: Read-only snapshot importer with path/size rules and no execution of repository scripts.
Text and PNG/JPEG evidence storage with opaque IDs, private provenance and bounded retrieval.
acceptance: Repository import never executes lifecycle hooks or follows forbidden links.
An evidence upload/path cannot expose host files or become executable HTML; contributors cannot fetch it.

tasks.title: Demo and private-model providers
deliverables: Provider interface, fixture-driven demo provider and local Ollama adapter.
Validated typed proposals, timeouts, one bounded repair, provenance and no tool authority.
Demo and model schemas propose connected work-unit/interface graphs and complete outcomes; support is not selected by exclusive discipline tags.
acceptance: Malformed/timeout/tool-call responses never create an approved/publishable intent.
Demo/mock/live modes remain distinguishable; endpoint is operator-controlled; no private egress to an unapproved provider.

tasks.title: PM outcome review and decisions
deliverables: Goal/evidence form, facts/assumptions/unknowns presentation, before/after preview and internal decision UI.
Owner approval of exact intent revision with private traceability.
acceptance: A goal entered without technical detail produces a reviewable draft in demo mode.
Required unresolved decisions block preparation; edit-after-approval invalidates affected downstream evidence.
Previews use trusted templates/escaped data or an opaque-origin sandbox; proposed code never executes in the private console origin.
PM can describe a full-stack or codebase policy outcome; owner can review one composed task without being forced to create separate layer bounties.

tasks.title: Dependency/capability analysis
deliverables: TypeScript AST/import closure, edit-surface report and conservative unsupported-feature classification.
Detect protected imports, dynamic loading, unsafe globals and omitted state dependencies.
acceptance: Known forbidden coupling is rejected; unknown dynamic behaviour is not marked safe.
Reports disclose assumptions and limits; AST linting is never labeled semantic confidentiality proof.

tasks.title: Composable source and API boundary adapters
deliverables: Frontend component, backend pure-module and scoped backend API work-unit proposals with public interfaces and one private integration map for a coherent task.
Cost/retained-work record and explicit unsupported capability results; never silently omit a connected responsibility or split a task by layer.

Implement bounded AST extraction/parameterization that creates a new typed public boundary while retaining protected rule computation in a private adapter; check the proposed private diff before approval.
acceptance: Private eligibility/scoring remain in private adapters while contributor obligations are meaningful.
Each external requirement traces privately to approved intent; unsupported requirements are recorded instead of silently dropped.

A fixture initially coupled to a protected module acquires a newly typed boundary; static type and transformation-model checks pass. Actual generated-code preservation/integration execution remains a pending gate for M4.3 after M5.2/M5.3. Existing-interface packaging alone is insufficient.

The coherent selection fixture produces connected UI/API units and frozen request/context/response obligations; private eligibility remains in a retained adapter and no production authentication/billing capability is claimed.

tasks.title: Contract sufficiency and bounded ranker checks
deliverables: Independent property checker and 0..4-item bounded ranker model.
Caller-assumption checks, alternative satisfying implementations and package-defect counterexample fixture.
Check composed interface/end-to-end obligation completeness, including a client/API mismatch counterexample that passes local unit checks.
acceptance: Local contract and private caller assumptions are both checked in stated bounds.
An alternative valid implementation is accepted; a missing private requirement is classified as package defect; all bounds/unknowns are reported.
Contract checking distinguishes missing published obligations from implementation errors; all required units/interfaces must be supported and unit success alone cannot imply complete fit.

tasks.title: Bounded application security-policy adapter
deliverables: Implement application_policy for the versioned response-security JSON schema in COMPOSITION.md; register data-only parse/schema/constraint checks and private loader mapping.
Generate a PM-reviewed policy task or policy work unit within a composed task, with exact approved values, edit path, HTTPS/localhost semantics and preservation obligations.
Track broader security/cloud/data/tooling requirements individually; absence of a suitable adapter is explicit and never inferred just from the discipline.
acceptance: A response-security policy task has a runnable frozen contract and generic synthetic fixtures; policy code never selects evaluator commands, dependencies, routes or privileges.
Reject duplicate JSON keys, unknown fields, executable/remote references and out-of-scope edits; valid declared alternatives remain eligible.
Static/schema feasibility passes here; runtime transfer and preservation remain mandatory after the real runner gates.

tasks.title: Release review and approval binding
deliverables: Review exact listing/contract/assets/feedback/terms; stage approved content-addressed bytes.
Owner approval signatures bound to hashes, versions and frozen policy.
Review combined public meaning, interfaces and capability union across all work units; one owner approval covers the exact whole task.
acceptance: Editing any approved byte, policy or template requires reapproval.
AI/worker cannot approve; a displayed summary cannot replace review of actual released contents.

tasks.title: Approved-only compiler and workspace templates
deliverables: Deterministic ZIP/manifest build with composable vetted fragments for frontend, pure module, backend API and application policy; assemble one offline-capable workspace with fixed shared toolchain/start/check instructions.
Pinned trusted public image with required dependencies and runnable public checks.
acceptance: Two different private systems with identical approved inputs produce byte-identical packages.
Package excludes private mappings/canaries/history/cache/source maps; compiler has no arbitrary private-path or model access.
Execution image layers/history contain no private files/canaries; images are built exclusively from public/vetted inputs.
Single-unit, connected full-stack and policy packages compile; schema/toolchain collisions and dangling interfaces fail; changing one unit/interface invalidates whole-package approval.

tasks.title: Readiness records and publish gate
deliverables: Fresh-build, traceability, ambiguity and external-context solve/human-review evidence model.
Readiness UI, failure reasons and immutable package version.

Run fresh readiness checks in the real isolated profile; baseline builds and harness self-validation must work even though unfinished feature tests may fail. Private reference patches validate feasibility without being exported.
acceptance: Any missing mandatory readiness or approval blocks publication.
A failed external AI solve is classified, not automatically called ambiguity or a proof of human difficulty.
Execute preservation/integration checks for the proposed private boundary diff in the validated isolated runner; pending M3 transformation evidence cannot be treated as completed runtime evidence.

Coherent full-stack and policy reference patches pass actual unit/interface/end-to-end/private-fit/preservation checks; initial unfinished feature tests may fail but baseline tooling and harness self-validation must work.

tasks.title: Runner protocol and safe controller
deliverables: Bounded job/result schemas, trusted command mapping, digest/replay verification and SSH/SFTP transport.
Capability doctor, fake-development adapter and required dedicated-VM adapter.
Implement the operator-host KVM/libvirt baseline-to-ephemeral-guest provider and explicit per-job VM lease disposal.
acceptance: Untrusted commands/URLs/harness IDs cannot control host execution.
Fake runner is explicit; missing/invalid required profile fails closed and leaves real-validation tasks blocked.

tasks.title: Sandboxed jobs and adversarial runtime checks
deliverables: Non-root constrained container inside dedicated VM; offline dependencies and per-job disposal.
Good, network/file-read, output-flood, loop/process/memory and forged-result cases.
Keep authenticated supervisor/harness authority outside candidate process/container; frontend driver is outside candidate renderer. Public/private jobs use distinct fresh VMs and inputs.
acceptance: Good jobs run; forbidden access/egress and resource abuse are blocked or terminated under actual recorded controls.
No host/private-store/model/socket/cloud credentials are present; raw results remain private; tests really execute, not mock, the VM boundary.
Forged verdict stdout, process.exit(0), assertion monkeypatching and cross-job persistence cannot yield passing authority or survive guest destruction.

tasks.title: Jobs, cancellation and evaluator evidence
deliverables: Transactional enqueue/cancel/result states, immutable harness/image binding and bounded private log storage.
Public-vs-private evaluation job separation with exact artifact linkage.
acceptance: Timeouts, corrupted/replayed results and interrupted jobs never become passed/accepted.
Evidence binds evaluated bytes and revisions; job cleanup cannot affect another workspace or active job.

tasks.title: Composed services and aggregate evaluation authority
deliverables: Implement fixed per-job browser/static-assets/candidate-API proxy profile, separate candidate process/container boundaries, data-only policy validation and trusted aggregate verdicts per COMPOSITION.md.
Bind all work-unit/interface/package/harness digests to one authorized attempt; aggregate CPU/memory/process/time/storage limits and clean up every service/network/guest on cancellation.

Run positive full-stack and policy cases plus mismatched client/API, missing unit result, forged success, privilege-changing policy and forbidden network/management access cases in the real VM profile.

Exercise fixed proxy method/route/upstream rules, renderer isolation from CDP/SSH/signing channels, forged forwarding/Host headers and trusted application-policy application after candidate API output.
acceptance: Browser checks exercise the actual candidate API through fixed internal routes; trusted supervisor/signing authority remains inaccessible to every candidate.
Unit success with failed interface/end-to-end or missing required evidence cannot pass; one submission attempt is counted once even when it starts multiple bounded child jobs.
Public/private composition jobs use separate fresh VMs and input bundles; pure modules stay network-none and policies never execute as scripts. Real resource/egress/disposal evidence is required.

Run passing and failing frontend+backend+policy patches in real separate public/private VMs. A candidate response header cannot override trusted application policy; policy cannot relax evaluator controls; forged ingress context and proxy tunneling/redirect/route escape fail.

tasks.title: Signed release bridge and local task board
deliverables: Signed approved envelope delivery with nonce/expiry/replay protection and public positive projections.
Local board and exact package retrieval; no external publishing integration.
acceptance: External DB contains released data only; guessed private IDs/errors do not expose context.
Unsigned/stale/replayed envelope is rejected; published assets match approved hashes.
Board displays nonexclusive skills/discipline tags and the whole composed scope; reservation/package remain one task and one fixed reward.

tasks.title: Assignments, reservations and package-defect flow
deliverables: Customer choice of human/AI/team, invitations, one-reservation transaction and expiry.
Contributor download/instructions and structured package-defect report.
acceptance: Customer executor choice persists without AI-first routing.
Concurrent reservations cannot both win; expiry/defect/cancellation uses frozen terms; no chat or private AI endpoint exists.
Revisions preserve original expiry/terms; changes_required reactivates the reservation and old attempts cannot be accepted.

tasks.title: Bounded patch intake and atomic budgets
deliverables: UTF-8 patch parsing, strict portable paths/edit allowlist, digest and reservation validation.
Idempotency and reservation/lineage/workspace attempt counters, private bounded submission import.
External DB owns atomic quota/attempt-permit/outbox commit; signed permits authorize idempotent private import and recovery.
acceptance: Traversal, Windows unsafe paths, evaluator/manifest edits, binary/mode/submodule changes and forged bases fail before execution.
Concurrent identities/versions cannot bypass limits; duplicate idempotency keys create one attempt; no patch executes on the host.
Crash/replay tests prove no evaluation without a committed permit and no duplicate authoritative attempt across the bridge.
One bounded patch may edit approved paths across units; authoritative attempt quotas do not reset or multiply by work-unit count.

tasks.title: Public checks and private integration pipeline
deliverables: Frozen public and private VM jobs, template-specific patch mapping and evidence classification.
Private candidate diff produced as data against exact base; no merge/deploy.
Map all units/shared interfaces into one pinned private base and aggregate required public/private/end-to-end/preservation evidence; include response-policy loader verification.
acceptance: Compatible changes pass published/private-fit checks; genuine violations fail; infrastructure/unknown results remain distinct.
Stale versions trigger revalidation; hidden tests introduce no unpublished obligation.

A mismatch patch whose unit checks pass fails whole-task fit; a correct composed patch creates one aggregate candidate diff. An unpublished private expectation is package_defect, not contributor fault.

tasks.title: Owner review and controlled feedback
deliverables: Private evidence review, owner-only acceptance and approved public feedback renderer.
Feedback policy version, public-only diagnostics and package-defect compensation path.
Atomically record exact latest-attempt acceptance, candidate-diff hash, payment obligation and feedback outbox in the private DB; M7.3 adds settlement/ledger UI and exports.
acceptance: Only owner accepts exact checked revision; AI/jobs do not self-approve.
Canary/raw logs/stack traces/private scores never appear in public responses; terminal status is identified as approved intentional disclosure.
Crash/retry/supersession cannot expose accepted without a payable record or create duplicate payable/feedback events.
Partial unit passes cannot be separately accepted or create implicit payments; one exact complete task acceptance binds all evaluated unit/interface hashes.

tasks.title: Idempotent ledger and research event capture
deliverables: Payment-obligation and owner-recorded settlement/compensation ledger, safe CSV export.
Stage/time/effort, rejection, clarification, retained-work and assurance records.
acceptance: Concurrent acceptance cannot create duplicate payable events; no real payment claim/API exists.
Package defects are not silently contributor fault; missing effort data is null, and private financial projections obey release policy.

tasks.title: Adversarial boundary verification
deliverables: Complete mandatory attack suite and evidence report from SECURITY.md.
Open findings with severity, trusted assumptions and limits; no unsupported security claims.
Independently challenge composite disclosure, API proxy privileges, data-only policy handling, verdict aggregation and shared-path ownership gates.
acceptance: All decisive adversarial tests run with independent expected outcomes and actual VM jobs where required.
Any unresolved blocker prevents pilot-ready status; positive good-submission cases still work.

tasks.title: External-only cold-start and alternatives
deliverables: Fresh external-only workspace build/check/submit rehearsal and alternative satisfying patches.
Incomplete package, support failure and defect-report classification; explicit human-readiness evidence field.

Run the actual fresh package-only build/rehearsal in an isolated workspace. A solver, when available, has fresh context and package-only tool/filesystem exposure; full-history/shared-repository solves are labeled limited rehearsal.
acceptance: Rehearsal has no private references/model/context; valid alternatives transfer privately.
An agent solve is recorded as an agent solve; no human independence evidence is fabricated.

Record mechanical rehearsal separately from blind solver and human evidence. Missing a constrained solver/human does not fabricate evidence; implementation can pass its mechanical gate while those research fields remain unverified.
Cold-start mechanical readiness covers the connected full-stack package and response-policy package; valid alternatives pass aggregate private transfer, not merely isolated unit checks.

tasks.title: Research instruments and breadth records
deliverables: Versioned study templates and synthetic examples with nonexclusive frontend/backend/security/cloud/data/tooling tags, work-unit/adapter/interface records and distinct composition cohorts.
Reports implementing EVALUATION metrics, missing-value rules and explicit unevaluated hypotheses.
acceptance: Rejected and retained-private work remain in denominator; no unsupported discipline is counted implemented.
Synthetic/empty inputs report insufficient evidence; participant/expert superiority claims require genuine evidence.
A composed task counts once in the unique task denominator; overlapping discipline counts are labeled and never summed into fictional breadth.

tasks.title: End-to-end PM to accepted contribution
deliverables: Complete single-unit compatibility, coherent full-stack selection and executable response-security policy journeys, including intent/approval/invalidation/reservation/patch/aggregate review/ledger states.
Usable responsive UI, loading/error states and accessibility smoke checks.
Complete the combined frontend/backend/policy journey; a local-unit-pass/aggregate-fail patch never reaches accepted or creates a payable record.
acceptance: PM can describe an outcome and owner/contributor complete the prescribed workflow without bypassing gates.
Invalidation, task defects and failed jobs appear honestly; correct patches integrate as candidate diffs only.

Full-stack success requires one task/contract/package/reward with working UI-to-candidate-API behaviour; response-security policy completes private loader/preservation checks. Frontend+backend+policy also completes one combined journey with passing and failing real-runner patches, aggregate owner acceptance and one payable event; no exclusive family rule remains.

tasks.title: Fresh-environment and capability verification
deliverables: Clean-install verification, credential-free demo instructions and real VM setup/run documentation.
Workspace-scoped backup/restore, interrupted-job recovery and machine-readable delivery status.
acceptance: Mandatory real-runner gate must pass; missing VM is a blocker, not a successful mock substitute.
Live model verification is either genuinely observed or clearly needs_configuration; backups do not export private data into external storage.
Runtime verification excludes the final coordinator task-state audit so M9.3 can execute its checks before its own completion.
verify:mvp requires full-stack and executable policy pathways plus real composite runner gates; future unsupported adapters remain explicit capability gaps.

tasks.title: Final independent review and delivery report
deliverables: Evidence-backed milestone audit, exact commands/URLs and current limitations.
Separate statuses for software, VM runner, live provider, independent review and real human study; next research steps.
Report exact implemented adapters/compositions and unsupported capability boundaries; avoid claiming all codebase disciplines or arbitrary cloud work are already supported.
acceptance: No unresolved mandatory implementation/security gates or invented successes.
User can start/resume from documented instructions; software delivery never implies H1/H2 are proved or real participants were paid.
